# Preserve dotted account-control IDs as data-binding names

Current save/restore splits each control ID at the first dot into a source type and a remaining property slot; BrowseForLocalFolders looks up server.localPath. A scoped naming recommendation for these existing Account Settings controls is to preserve that type.slot contract and change both markup and binding logic if it must change. A generic rule to convert all DOM IDs to dash-case or camelCase would break this family. Nested slot dots are retained because code slices the rest of the ID rather than using only vals[1]. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: account settings DOM naming.
